name: DJMax Respect: V Liberty 3 Pack
summary:
DJMax Respect: V Liberty 3 Pack is a rhythm game DLC that adds new original songs to the base game. The V Liberty 3 Pack features music from diverse composers and is playable on the same difficulty and modes as the base game.

Track list:
- Checkmate (feat. Re.may)
- CHiNEM4TiC
- DJ_Joseon (feat. E_Omong, Pandalang)
- Fly with me (feat. Jungmihwang)
- Hero
- I'm Dizzy

- Love, Epilogue (feat. mill)
